sections.heading: Tuition and Fees
sections.text:
Tuition and fees for each level of study vary at NYU SPS, but it is important to stay informed about the costs related to your specific area of study. Please check back for updates each academic year to ensure you are aware of any changes from the previous year.

Note: Tuition for the semester will vary based upon the total number of credit hours for which a student is formally enrolled. Enrollment above the base price may incur additional tuition and fees. Check the NYU Bursar site for more information.

A wide variety of financial aid, scholarships, and loans are available to help support your financial needs. Visit the tuition and financial aid page to be sure you are able to make the most of the options offered.
